name: fight with me
source:
A short game filled with tips, ideas and quotes relating to psychological issues

The design of the player's friend Han is inspired by Han Jisung from the k-pop group [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stray_Kids]Stray Kids[/url].

[From [url=https://alisalol.itch.io/fight-with-me]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款简短的游戏，包含与心理问题相关的建议、想法和引言。

玩家的朋友Han是以K-pop组合Stray Kids的韩知城为灵感设计的。

[来源：[url=https://alisalol.itch.io/fight-with-me]Itch.io[/url]]
